mechanics.claim: The cone swing lands 0.25 seconds into the 1-second cast time, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: After {{fd|0.25}} seconds into the cast time, '''Sejuani''' swings her flail in a cone

mechanics.claim: The line lash happens after the cast time ends, from Sejuani's position at that time, and slows enemies hit by 75% for 0.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: After the cast time, '''Sejuani''' lashes out with her flail in a line in the same direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Sejuani can move during the cast time, which does not change damage output.
mechanics.quote: '''''Sejuani''' can move during Winter's Wrath's cast time.''

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one of the two hits (swing or lash), not both.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} will block only a single instance of damage - either the swing or the lash.

mechanics.claim: Both the swing and the lash strike in the original cast direction, but the lash originates from Sejuani's location at the end of the cast time.
mechanics.quote: Both swings will strike in the cast direction, but the second swing will do so from '''Sejuani's''' location at the end of the cast time.
